purpose: Validate several real records per candidate source and broaden extreme-weather coverage before task expansion.
data_use: availability and schema probes only; not admitted benchmark episodes
selection: 43 named source families from master43 plus explicitly recorded complementary products; reuse earlier complete samples only with fresh hashes and declared provenance
sample_rule: Aim for >=3 identifiable records/windows/scenes per accessible source. Not random or representative; event and quality eligibility separate. Unsuccessful sources remain in denominator.
